name: GET /api/leadflow/leads/:id/routing-trace - why this rep
description:
The recorded reason a lead went where it did, step by step.

THE STORED REASON, NOT ONE RECOMPUTED NOW. Re-deriving it would answer "which rule would match today", and the rules have changed since — which is usually exactly why somebody is asking. A trace that silently reflects current configuration is worse than no trace, because it looks authoritative while describing a decision that was never made.

testCases.name: NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.when: the lead id does not exist.

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
